transcript: Tonight I went to See Theater for a New Audiences production of Des Moines by Dennis Johnson. This play was absurdist, funny, sad, and confusing, but I actually really enjoyed it. Without getting into too much detail, this play depicts 5 quirky people together over a very drunken, festive, yet melancholy evening. The performances, I thought were outstanding and brought a lot of depth to the text that otherwise was pretty tricky to comprehend. This play definitely gave me a lot to chew on for my train ride home. With that, another playbill goes into my collection, the first of 2023.
